name: Salt Pans
desc: A field of salt-evaporation ponds running to a hazed horizon — a receding grid of coloured cells (pink, rust, teal, green) walled off by pale salt berms, brine concentrating cell by cell so each holds a different hue, heat shimmering off the far pans, specular light shivering on the wet ones and dust drifting across; industrial colour ponds, a white salar mirror sheet, a warm sunset, a saturated multispectral false-colour survey, or sumi ink.

energy.doc: how hard the light works — heat shimmer, specular glints, cell contrast

scale.doc: how large the cells read — grid cell size (rebuilds the field)

density.doc: how many pond rows and columns, and crust mottling

wet.doc: how flooded the pans are — reflection and specular strength vs dry crust

haze.doc: how thick the horizon haze is — how far back the pans fade

hue.doc: palette hue shift across the whole pond colour set

x.doc: the vanishing bias — which way the grid converges and the light rakes

y.doc: the horizon line — low y gives more pans, high y more sky

style.doc: aesthetic: ponds = industrial colour evaporation cells, pale salt berms; salar = white salt flat with a thin mirror water sheet, minimal colour; sunset = cells glowing pink-gold with long berm shadows; false_color = saturated multispectral survey blocks; ink = sumi tonal cells and berms, monochrome

act.doc: multi-minute programme — brine slowly concentrating and shifting colour, a flooding that spreads reflection over sections, or a drying that hardens the crust and raises the shimmer

seed.doc: regenerates the cell colours, grid layout, crust mottle and haze

alpha.doc: how far the world sits back behind the performers
